package repository

import (
	"context"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
)

type StudentOnboardingDraftReplaceCommand struct {
	StudentID       string
	RequestID       string
	RequestHash     string
	ExpectedVersion int64
	Answers         domain.StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers
	OccurredAt      time.Time
}

type StudentOnboardingDraftFinalizeCommand struct {
	StudentID              string
	RequestID              string
	RequestHash            string
	ExpectedDraftVersion   int64
	ExpectedProfileVersion int64
	OccurredAt             time.Time
}

// StudentOnboardingDraftRepository owns draft commands and their durable
// receipts. Finalize commits the profile and completed draft tombstone together.
type StudentOnboardingDraftRepository interface {
	GetDraft(ctx context.Context, studentID string) (domain.StudentOnboardingDraft, error)
	ReplaceDraft(
		ctx context.Context,
		command StudentOnboardingDraftReplaceCommand,
	) (domain.StudentOnboardingDraft, bool, error)
	FinalizeDraft(
		ctx context.Context,
		command StudentOnboardingDraftFinalizeCommand,
	) (domain.StudentOnboardingFinalizeResult, bool, error)
}
